title: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Form 10-K (synthetic)
text: Net interest income peaked in the prior year and faded 7% as deposit costs caught the asset-yield book. Management described a peak-and-fade NII path: the 2024 high water was not repeated, and 2026 guidance assumes a further modest fade if the curve stays inverted in the front end. CET1 was 15.1% at year end, above the 13.6% standardized requirement plus buffers. The firm said the CET1 surplus is the capacity that funds the fade without cutting the payout.
